abstract_en: A laboratory-based course on sensors, robots and data-driven control in modern factories, taught on the Eastbrook engineering campus.
description_en: Students program a small production line with industrial controllers, connect it to a monitoring dashboard and test predictive maintenance strategies. Theory sessions on automation standards and cybersecurity of production systems accompany the weekly lab.
learning_outcomes_en: Design and program a simple automated production cell; integrate sensor data into a monitoring system; evaluate maintenance strategies; assess basic cybersecurity risks of connected machines.
prerequisites_en: Bachelor-level control engineering or electronics, and basic programming.
assessment_en: Lab reports (40%), a team project demonstration (40%) and a written exam (20%).
methods_en: Lectures, weekly lab sessions and a team project.
remarks_en: Open only to students enrolled at an alliance university because laboratory places are limited.

abstract_en: A COIL course in which mixed teams from at least two universities develop the business model of a social enterprise from idea to pitch.
description_en: Each team works with a partner team at another university of the alliance. Sessions cover problem definition, impact measurement, financing models for social enterprises and legal forms in different countries. A jury of founders and investors scores the final pitches.
learning_outcomes_en: Develop a business model for a social enterprise; define and measure social impact; compare legal and financing options across countries; collaborate in a virtual international team.
prerequisites_en: None. A first course in management or economics is useful but not required.
assessment_en: Team deliverables at three milestones (60%), the final pitch (25%) and an individual reflection (15%).
instructors: Senior Lecturer in Entrepreneurship|Mentor from the regional start-up network
methods_en: Collaborative online international learning with mentoring and peer feedback.
remarks_en: A tuition-free place is guaranteed to students of alliance universities; others pay a small administration fee.
